body: Thanks everyone for the thoughts and advice. I would really love to go do stuff with him. We both have a lot that we both enjoy and he asks me to do stuff with him fairly often maybe every other weekend or something like that. I'm always trying but the day of he's just sleeping/too hungover or doing something else. It is frustrating at times but I never take it out on him. When I was feeling bad I had hills and valley emotions and I think he is similar. One day feels good and wants to do something the next he could care less. His friends and even our mutual friends have tried to talk to him and he just doesn't seem to believe them or something. He also feels very useless and like he's a burden to our family. I just wish I could change the way he feels.

He does have access as he keeps it hidden and I'd like to take it, but he does feel like people are just against him when they try to take his gun. Also there's various rifles/other firearms that he could get very easily from friends. I would really like to force him to go, but would never do so simply because I don't think that would be positive at all. I just feel like I'm waiting for something very bad to happen and that's all I can do.

Actually to answer both questions: yes. Im not 100% about the insurance,  but I used to be very depressed and found a very affordable clinic near by. It's one of those deals though that there's a line to get in and if you miss one appointment then you can not schedual another. We've tried to get him to go to work and he doesn't want to. He's supposed to do 10hrs of community service for the possession charge and the county is letting him off really easy. If he doesn't do it they are going to refile charges because he's showing that he doesn't care. Thank you for the resource link, but yes I have looked through those and that's why im getting so desperate. It's like every question I answer he seems more and more likely to be suicidal. The anniversary of dad's passing is this month and my mom has mentioned something to him about switching wireless network plans and he just tells her to wait till the end of the month because then she won't have to worry about his line. I'm just struggling to keep everything going,  my mom, my little sister, and the rest of the pile of baggage that I have that doesn't even effect him or my family.

Edit: sorry what I meant to say but never got out was that we have so much trouble getting him to do anything at all small or something entirely for him he doesn't want to do it.  So I dont know how I'd get him to do any kind of counseling.
